answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a defined half-life, so influence must be earned through sustained, reciprocal honest service rather than briefly accumulated endorsements. In the EigenTrust matrix, a freshly spawned identity has almost no incoming trusted weight and therefore near-zero eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot amplify unsupported links enough to satisfy consensus thresholds. Trust follows verified paths, like a river winding past a jetty and through a canyon, not identities invented overnight.
